title: Pending cache entry has no failure arm: a tokenizer job that never lands leaves the block plain for the session
trigger: A pre block with a language is drawn; the detached background tokenize job panics or its app goes away before cache().finish runs
effect: The block stays plain until restart; lookup() sees Entry::Pending forever and never re-issues the Job, and Pending entries are not in the LRU order so they never evict
fix: Pending { job: Task<()> } held in the cache (dropped entry cancels), plus Failed so a failed job is retried or shown plain on purpose

title: ClearStage::Spent waits for acks of messages that may never ack or fail, so the slot's DraftClear entry lives until a newer send replaces it (known leftover)
trigger: Send an album, delete one of its messages while it is still uploading (or TDLib refuses it without a failed update); the other messages ack
effect: Spent(messages) never reaches is_settled: the entry stays in ComposerSends::draft_clears for that slot (a bounded leak, one per slot); a later ack cannot clear another send's draft because take_draft_clear matches by message id or Unasked, so no wrong clear follows
fix: Drop the entry when the send's request is no longer in flight (answered request set in the stage), or when the temporary messages leave the history, instead of waiting for each message's ack

title: With Sync contacts off and a never-loaded list the Contacts tab reads Loading with nothing in flight, forever
trigger: Turn Sync contacts off, restart (users_state.contacts starts Fetch::Idle and nothing fetches it at login), open the Contacts tab: open_contacts_tab skips fetch_contacts because sync is off, then refetch_open_contacts calls refetch_invalidated_contacts, which returns unless the list is Outdated (Idle is not)
effect: contacts_list treats data().is_none() && !failed as Loading, so the tab shows Loading contacts... until Sync is switched back on (set_contact_sync fetches) or another screen asks for contacts; the comment in open_contacts_tab says such a list still loads
fields: Fetch::Idle for users_state.contacts and the draw rule loading = data().is_none() && !failed
fix: refetch_invalidated_contacts should also ask for an Idle list (can_ask) when the tab is open, and the tab should read a not-asked state (Idle) differently from Loading
